I went to school for a few years so I can read what is written on a seed packet or fertilizer bag, but I learned farming from my mother and from watching my neighbors. This plot is only 0.32 hectares and it is rented, so I will not put manure or buy chemical fertilizer here — that costs money I do not have, and I would rather save any manure for the land my family owns. I will plant maize seed I kept from last season because it is free and I know it will grow on this soil without extra chemicals, and I will weed it well with my own hands and my children’s help. I will not hire anyone because cash is too tight, so it will be about eighteen days of our own labor from clearing to harvest.
